status: Experimental: gameplay reported and neural processing corroborated for Cyberpunk 2077, 007 First Light and Atomic Heart on a limited AMD RDNA4 / Proton configuration; other setups unverified.

linux_source.source_origin: native/ and sources/ recovered from the authenticated archive

integration.static_root_binding_evidence: Official payload Win64 instructions at 0x180018593 through 0x18001861d bind root 0 and root 2 UAVs and root 1 constants. RDEF names/offsets independently inspected.
integration.synchronization: Execute original mode-0 producer and mode-2 final status shader; replace repeated matching mode-1 waits with one ordered handoff; execute original HIP completion marker and synchronize its stream before publishing completion.

startup_probes.scope: Exact v0.3.0 bounded flag-kernel probes on the null stream, grid 1x1x1 and block 32x1x1
startup_probes.payload_evidence: Pinned unmodified v0.3.0 payload RVAs 0x14e28..0x14ed6 and 0x14f70..0x15079; wrappers at 0x4fd0 and 0x50d0; flags are suballocated at 0x13b8f..0x13b9d
startup_probes.behavior: Forward original bounded kernels and synchronize their original stream; no synthetic flag stores or neural completion. Preserve resource pins when synchronization fails.
startup_probes.gpu_validation: Original bounded startup probes completed during gameplay diagnostics; full neural processing was subsequently validated after the recording correction.

recording_protocol.payload_evidence: Pinned unmodified payload RVAs 0x16b0c..0x16b62, 0x16c36..0x16cf0, 0x16e71..0x16ec1. Pinned DXBC mode-2 branch checks completion and writes status/counters.
previous_defects: Second mode-1 wait rejected because the first split cleared nr_armed_token
Mode 2 unconditionally rejected by mode > 1 validation
recording_protocol.correction: Repeated waits must match token, frame, exact flags/abort addresses and spin cap; one split per frame; original mode-2 status dispatch retained in the consumer suffix.
recording_protocol.baseline_reproduction: Actual old nr_ordered_commands.h rejects wait slice 2/16 and also rejects the finalizer after a single wait; DXGI_ERROR_INVALID_CALL 0x887a0001.
recording_protocol.cpu_validation: Actual new nr_ordered_commands.h passes single-wait and 4000-slice replays, malformed-sequence rejection and timeout/output-error handoff tests under ASan/UBSan.
recording_protocol.gpu_validation: Passed in the diagnostic.3 Cyberpunk session: prefix completion, input publication, HIP completion and consumer handoff.

swapchain_queue_fallback.scope: GetDevice(IID_ID3D12CommandQueue) on the vkd3d DXGI presenter; return only its owned queue with normal COM AddRef semantics
swapchain_queue_fallback.payload_evidence: Unchanged v0.3.0 RVAs 0x9920 (IUnknown-to-queue recording), 0x9b79..0x9c49 (lookup and GetDevice fallback), 0x9c4b..0x9cb7 (missing-queue/device checks)
swapchain_queue_fallback.cpu_validation: Actual pinned and patched function bodies tested with COM mocks under ASan/UBSan; missing queue reproduced before fix; exact owned queue identity, references and failure propagation pass after fix
swapchain_queue_fallback.gpu_validation: Passed in diagnostic.4 007 First Light and Atomic Heart gameplay with their documented OptiScaler profiles.

optiscaler_ffx_input_workaround.scope: OptiScaler 0.9.4-final (7534ad0), DLSS input to FSR 3.1 backend in 007 First Light and Atomic Heart; per-game DXGI spoofing settings differ
optiscaler_ffx_input_workaround.mechanism: Avoid OptiScaler FFX input detours and saved original dispatch trampolines that can bypass later NR interception; preserve DLSS input and the FSR 3.1 backend
optiscaler_ffx_input_workaround.validation: The documented DLSS-input route restored NR interception in 007; Atomic Heart subsequently completed neural processing without another runtime change.

validation.cpu_forwarding_and_sync_contracts_asan_u: passed, including startup probes in a suballocated flag buffer, no synthetic frame readiness, normal job completion, and failed-sync pin retention
validation.image_quality_and_performance: No controlled benchmark or image comparison. Session-specific performance measurements are omitted. Long-session stability remains unverified.
validation.diagnostic_build: Diagnostic.4 full D3D12 compile and 21 Python tests previously passed; subsequent 007 and Atomic Heart gameplay confirmed neural processing. This source snapshot changes documentation and packaging inputs only.
validation.recording_protocol_regression: passed: before/after replay, 1 and 4000 waits, preserved mode-2 dispatch, mismatched/unpaired rejection, Vulkan timeout cannot publish, HIP failure cannot report success
validation.swapchain_queue_regression: passed; actual before/after source under ASan/UBSan
validation.documentation_update_checks: Source digest consistency, local Markdown links, launch-template equivalence, package contents and privacy checks are verified when preparing the source snapshot; no new GPU test.
validation.AMD_Proton_gameplay: Passed on a limited AMD RDNA4 configuration: diagnostic.3 Cyberpunk; diagnostic.4 007 First Light and Atomic Heart.

distribution.reproducibility: Deterministic packaging of identical inputs; no cross-toolchain binary identity claim.

privacy.report_detail: Public profiles retain software configuration and bounded compatibility findings; personal paths, exact device inventory, session timestamps and session-specific measurements are omitted.
